subject: Shiny Running a Single File Shiny App

messages.author: d48c25039d976859
messages.subject: Shiny Running a Single File Shiny App
parts: How do I launch a single file Shiny from Shiny server? I normally just copy the ui and server files to the shiny-server dirtectory but I am trying to run a app that is in the shiny single file format. .

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Running a Single File Shiny App
parts:
Jason,

The single file should be called "app.R", and in a directory of its own in the same location where you server your other Shiny applications (default is /srv/shiny-server). Then you can access it with the name of directory. For example:

http://localhost:3838/single-file-app


Hope this helps,
Fereshteh
